# Judicium Arbitration

> Premier arbitration and Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR) law firm in North India. 20+ years of experience, 500+ commercial disputes resolved across 20+ practice areas. Offices in New Delhi (HQ), Gurgaon, Noida, Chandigarh, Jaipur, Panipat, Prayagraj, and Lucknow.

Judicium Arbitration represents clients in domestic and international commercial arbitration under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 (as amended in 2015, 2019, and 2021). The firm handles institutional arbitration before DIAC, MCIA, ICC, SIAC, and LCIA; ad-hoc arbitration; mediation and conciliation; Section 9 and Section 17 interim relief applications; emergency arbitrator proceedings; setting aside and enforcement proceedings; and foreign award enforcement under the New York Convention.

Practice areas span dispute resolution, banking and finance, corporate and commercial, capital markets, private equity, intellectual property, real estate and urban development, projects and infrastructure, insolvency and bankruptcy, competition and antitrust, labour and employment, data privacy and cybersecurity, insurance, technology / media / telecommunications, healthcare and life sciences, international trade and WTO, white collar crime, and defence / aviation / space.

Contact: Judiciumarbitration@gmail.com | +91-9899686394

## Cornerstone insights articles

- [Section 9 vs Section 17 of the Arbitration Act](https://www.judiciumarbitration.com/insights/section-9-vs-section-17-arbitration-act): When to approach a court vs the tribunal for interim relief.
- [What NN Global Means for Arbitration Agreements in India](https://www.judiciumarbitration.com/insights/nn-global-stamping-arbitration-agreements): Stamping and enforceability of arbitration clauses, 2024–2026.
- [Enforcing Foreign Arbitral Awards in India under the New York Convention](https://www.judiciumarbitration.com/insights/foreign-award-enforcement-india-new-york-convention): Part II Arbitration Act procedure, Section 48 grounds, and timelines.
- [DIAC vs MCIA vs IAMC](https://www.judiciumarbitration.com/insights/diac-vs-mcia-choosing-arbitral-institution-india): Choosing between India's leading arbitral institutions.
- [RERA and Arbitration: Builder-Buyer Disputes](https://www.judiciumarbitration.com/insights/rera-arbitration-builder-buyer-disputes-india): Why builder-buyer disputes are non-arbitrable, and where arbitration still applies in real estate.
- [Emergency Arbitrator Orders in India after Amazon v. Future Retail](https://www.judiciumarbitration.com/insights/emergency-arbitrator-india-amazon-future-retail): How emergency arbitrator awards became enforceable in India-seated arbitration via Section 17.
- [Section 11 Arbitrator Appointment after In Re Interplay (2023)](https://www.judiciumarbitration.com/insights/section-11-arbitrator-appointment-in-re-interplay): The narrowed scope of judicial scrutiny at the appointment stage and the stamping question.

## Practice areas (high-priority)

- [Arbitration & Alternative Dispute Resolution](https://www.judiciumarbitration.com/practice-areas/arbitration-alternative-dispute-resolution): Flagship practice covering domestic, international commercial, and investment treaty arbitration; DIAC/MCIA/ICC/SIAC/LCIA proceedings; Section 9 and Section 17 emergency relief; award enforcement.
- [Banking & Finance](https://www.judiciumarbitration.com/practice-areas/banking-finance): SARFAESI, DRT proceedings, NCLT applications, loan recovery, fraud investigations, regulatory compliance under RBI norms.
- [Corporate & Commercial](https://www.judiciumarbitration.com/practice-areas/corporate-commercial): Companies Act 2013, contract drafting, shareholder disputes, joint ventures, corporate governance.
- [Real Estate & Urban Development](https://www.judiciumarbitration.com/practice-areas/real-estate-urban-development): RERA proceedings, builder-buyer disputes, conveyancing, title due diligence, land acquisition.
- [Intellectual Property Rights](https://www.judiciumarbitration.com/practice-areas/intellectual-property-rights): Patent, trademark, copyright, design; infringement litigation; IP licensing; IP-related arbitration.
- [Insolvency & Bankruptcy](https://www.judiciumarbitration.com/practice-areas/insolvency-bankruptcy): IBC 2016 proceedings, CIRP, liquidation, NCLT and NCLAT representation.
- [Dispute Resolution & Litigation](https://www.judiciumarbitration.com/practice-areas/dispute-resolution-litigation): Commercial court litigation, Supreme Court and High Court matters, civil and commercial disputes.
- [Capital Markets](https://www.judiciumarbitration.com/practice-areas/capital-markets): SEBI compliance, IPO advisory, securities disputes, listing obligations.
- [Competition & Antitrust](https://www.judiciumarbitration.com/practice-areas/competition-antitrust): CCI proceedings, merger control, abuse of dominance, cartel investigations.
- [Data Privacy & Cybersecurity](https://www.judiciumarbitration.com/practice-areas/data-privacy-cybersecurity): DPDP Act 2023 compliance, IT Act, breach response.
- [Labour & Employment](https://www.judiciumarbitration.com/practice-areas/labour-employment): Industrial Disputes Act, POSH compliance, employment contracts, wrongful termination.
